g.text: Early warning helps. Stopping still has a price.
Predict failure • Protect recovery • Report savings and success loss together
Tool errors may recover; normal returns
Parent task families stay in one split.
Real Kimi agent · ticket & incident workflows.
20 templates; 5 conditions; ≤12 tool calls per run.
Success: required writes + correct final state;
Errors / retries · tool context · resources · writes
Only observed events; no future or verifier data.
Compare LR, KNN and rules. Select the threshold
on validation with a 5% false-stop budget.
LR: logistic regression · KNN: k-nearest neighbors
IQR boxes · 1.5 × IQR whiskers · all outliers
Most alerts follow the first violation
were warned before their first violation.
One LLM, two workflows, two test families;
no online intervention experiment in this batch.
Scoring follows the tool return; the same alert
cannot undo a write that has already happened.
Not yet a loss-free stop policy.

a.text: Source: final research report, 6 Nov 2026 · Concept illustration: Seedream 5.5
